description: Parity Groups - Sites that must maintain the same Gross rates regardless of their MW Zone differences. During MW revision, the HIGHEST Gross in a parity group is applied to ALL sites in that group.

parity_groups.name: UFF Bangalore
parity_groups.notes: SBLZ is Zone 2 but follows Zone 1 rates for parity

parity_groups.name: UFF Delhi-NCR
parity_groups.notes: PDL1/PDL5 are HY (MW 16781), PDL2/UDL4 are DL (MW 20371/22411) - same Gross

parity_groups.name: AMZL Delhi-NCR-Faridabad
parity_groups.notes: HY sites (MW 18501) and DL sites (MW 22411) share same Gross. FADA CSDL is exception (has higher Gross).
